title: Prepare and clear a customs shipment
summary: A reviewed shipment declaration and release record reconciled to duties, transport and retained supporting evidence.
outcomes: A reviewed shipment declaration and release record reconciled to duties, transport and retained supporting evidence.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: Before goods cross a customs border or when a shipment is held or its declaration needs correction.

parts.title: Assemble the shipment and customs facts
parts.guidance: Collect origin, destination, transit route, goods descriptions, quantities, values, commercial invoices and transport records. Identify importer, exporter, buyer, seller and proposed representative; missing destination or responsible-party facts block preparation.

parts.title: Confirm registration and the customs procedure
parts.guidance: The customs owner or qualified broker confirms the responsible trader, required registrations, classification, origin, valuation, restrictions and procedure for the actual route. EORI registration alone does not clear goods; Northern Ireland, temporary movements and controlled goods require separate assessment.

parts.title: Prepare the declaration and supporting dossier
parts.guidance: Prepare the declaration data and document checklist under the broker-approved classification and procedure. Reconcile quantities and values to commercial records and flag missing licences, certificates, origin evidence or inconsistent transport instructions.

parts.title: Approve the declaration and representation mandate
parts.guidance: The accountable trader approves the exact declaration data, broker mandate, payment arrangements and shipment instructions. Resolve missing permits and uncertain classifications before submission; do not infer that a carrier accepts importer responsibility.

parts.title: Submit and coordinate customs release
parts.guidance: The authorized declarant or broker submits through the applicable customs route, handles official requests and arranges approved duty or tax payment. Retain declaration references and release or hold messages; physical delivery alone does not establish customs acceptance.

parts.title: Reconcile release and retain the audit record
parts.guidance: Match accepted declarations, release evidence and paid or deferred amounts to the shipment and ledger. Assign amendments, returns, transit discharge and rejected declarations to their owners and preserve the applicable supporting records.
